description: Retrieve the full WoRMS Aphia record for a taxon by its AphiaID. Returns complete taxonomy (kingdom to genus), accepted name and authority, valid AphiaID for synonyms, citation string, LSID (life science identifier), habitat flags, and last-modified date. Use this to resolve synonym chains — if status is "unaccepted", valid_AphiaID points to the accepted taxon. Source: World Register of Marine Species, CC BY 4.0.

aphia_id.description: WoRMS AphiaID — the unique numeric identifier for a taxon (e.g. 137102 for Orcinus orca). Obtain via worms.species.search.

name: worms.species.details

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: WoRMS Species Details
